PHARMACOLOGICAL BASIS: Lisdexamfetamine is a prodrug that releases d-amphetamine upon hydrolysis. Citalopram is a selective serotonin reuptake inhibitor (SSRI). Coadministration can lead to excessive serotonergic tone, precipitating serotonin syndrome - a potentially life-threatening condition characterized by neuromuscular excitation, hyperthermia, and altered mental status.
